market_base_token_supply.meaning: baseToken supply of the small market before the mint

mint_amount.meaning: amount the attacker mints, equal to Q96

synthetic_tokens_unbacked.meaning: synthetic tokens exist without backing, i.e. complete protocol insolvency

assumptions: The mint amount and market supply are denominated in the same token unit so they are directly comparable.
The mint action is permissionless or the attacker is otherwise able to invoke mintLogic; the report does not establish an authorization guard.

unresolved.description: The report states the mint succeeds and produces unbacked synthetic tokens but does not give a numeric backing/reserve quantity, so the insolvency magnitude (79e30 multiplier) cannot be bound to a numeric conservation relation; it is carried as the boolean unbacked outcome.

limitations: The Q96 cap and market supply bound are formalized as a single bounded_value relation on mint_amount vs market_base_token_supply; the report's OR-of-two-conditions cap structure is not separately modeled.
Insolvency is represented as a boolean unbacked-token outcome rather than a numeric reserve deficit because no reserve quantity is reported.
